title: Anthropomorphization of AI: Opportunities and Risks

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing toxicity levels in ChatGPT outputs directed at different racial groups (e.g., South American vs. Asian) when the model is customized with different personas.
Comparing toxicity levels in generated text directed at different gender identities (e.g., non-binary vs. female) based on the assigned persona of the language model.
Evaluating how assigning different occupational personas (e.g., journalists vs. businesspersons) or historical figures via system parameters affects the toxicity of the model's output.
